Arrástrala a la ventana, pégala con <b>C: Drag it into the window, paste it with Ctrl+V or press Image. With the folder button you process all the images in a folder at once, and each one is analyzed separately. Supports PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP and TIFF.
<b>Auto</b> analiza la imagen y decide p: Auto analyzes the image and decides for you: it detects whether it's a photo or a drawing and picks the model and the size. Photo boosts realistic texture, Anime redraws lines and flat colors, and Light web produces a small JPG. You can also just convert to PNG or JPG without touching the quality.
<b>Tamaño auto</b> lleva las imágenes pe: Auto size takes small images up to about 3000 px and leaves large ones untouched. Same size only improves quality without enlarging. ×2, ×3 and ×4 enlarge the image. In the advanced options you can also choose how much of the AI enhancement is applied (the strength).
Al terminar, mueve el deslizador para ve: When it finishes, move the slider to see the before and after. The result is saved next to the original with the suffix _mejorado (or _convertido). Show opens the folder with the file already selected and Open opens it in your image viewer.
En <b>Video</b> mejoras un clip fotogram: In Video you enhance a clip frame by frame with AI or convert its format without re-encoding. In Settings → System & GPU you choose which GPU the AI uses and check that the models are detected; in Themes you switch between Classic and Miami, in light or dark.
Las imágenes pegadas o arrastradas se gu: Pasted or dragged images are saved in Imágenes\Reescaller.
Si dudas, deja Auto: casi siempre aciert: If in doubt, leave it on Auto: it almost always gets it right.
